description: The layout of layout trial attempt 23 (seed [2000, 23, 3]) at 0789f74, drawn from that commit's minerva-production-01 workcell and randomization files on coolserver (2026-10-18). The handoff demonstrator's trial on it aborted: about 0.64 s into 'right turns' a right finger met the held 50 x 47 x 48 mm block, the block forced the right's open jaws past their range and the receiver stopped on the right gripper's position_above_upper (5.2823 rad against 5.2791). A planner follow-up (docs/simulation/SIM_DEMONSTRATOR.md, "Follow-ups"); scripts/sim/repro_take_abort.py runs it.

sources.fiducials.rectangle.robot_offsets: randomized (training layout, minerva-production-01 training layouts, 2026-10-18): the tag rectangle moved with the table group (the file's [0.325, 0.36]: placeholder (interim, from head-camera torso clearance and reach (2026-10-18); not measured): (c, d), the rectangle's origin at base (c, -d), centred on the robot. The head camera is given in the rectangle frame, so d places it on the robot: rays through its whole image (the arms hanging) show the robot's torso until d = 0.318 m, and at the first placeholder (0.1584) the camera sat inside it. d = 0.36 keeps 4.2 cm of that margin and the camera 3.5 cm from the torso's nearest surface (3 cm asked). Planning the whole task for a cube at each 5 cm cell of the rectangle, with the box where the depth puts it: at d 0.33, 0.36, 0.40 and 0.45 the cube is picked in 81, 79, 70 and 61 of the 86 cells off the box, and the whole task, the release into the box included, plans and clears in 50, 50, 49 and 45. The user's tape numbers, or registering the robot to the head camera (docs/simulation/SIM_WORKCELL.md), replace it)

The table plane fitted to its depth (1.63 mm RMS) sets the camera's height, 554.9 mm, and its tilt, 45.59 degrees down; the flat tags 0, 3, 4 and 5 at their places in the rectangle set where it stands over the plane and its turn (3.4 px RMS, at most 4.2 px: the taped rectangle reads about 1.9% short of the depth, whose scale the tags' calipered squares confirm to 0.9%). With the D435 colour intrinsics. The tags alone put it 10.2 mm lower (544.7 mm up). In the rectangle frame, so it moves with the tags when rectangle.robot_offsets is measured; the image axes are those of the published, half-turned image) shifted by the drawn offset
